collector_requirements: Use a root-reviewed explicit source path/SHA256/byte/kind/classification list; no globs, recursive tree admission, broad profile namespace exception or generic FCStd bypass.

Retain the three specifically root-authorized generic geometry files as actual bytes with exact path/hash/size allowlisting. Other geometry admission remains separate. They are all below32MiB; an existing blanket FCStd rejection must be amended narrowly, not silently bypassed.

Preserve exact original bytes and literal original path/reference/status/fingerprint fields. Gzip may be deterministic storage only, with original/stored/decoded hashes and sizes; do not canonicalize JSON or repair links to the packet location.

Capture receipt/log/plan bytes once and parse those same buffers. Check all manifest/execution/identity/output descriptors, current bytes and sizes before copying and again at final handoff; reject missing or changed files.

Raw private app/profile inventories, sixteen-file dependency/stat inventories, user/system configs, environment dictionaries, caches, vendor trees, runtime executables/libraries and external Pixi payloads are excluded. Retain only their already-safe receipt descriptors/flags/hashes, not bodies.

Treat own-generated .prof as an explicitly typed diagnostic data artifact, not a runtime binary; never import/unmarshal/execute it in the collector. Keep binary-magic/runtime exclusions for all other payloads.

A payload can have multiple origin/role aliases only after exact hash and byte equality is verified. Store one body plus explicit role/origin metadata; do not rebind literal references or alias historical/live/restored/baseline/candidate files merely because names, counts or canonical semantics coincide.

Separate original raw file SHA256, parsed canonical comparison digest, stored gzip SHA256, captured native artifact SHA256 and whole app inventory digest. They are different identities and must not be substituted.

Require new-only publication paths, explicit exact index coverage, root plan hash approval, check-only verification before write, and independent final raw/decompressed byte/index/summary/crosslink verification after write.

Summary must distinguish current source HEAD, actual runtime commit/revision and selected module/native hashes for every run. Keep historical unprofiled durations separate from profiled baseline/candidate metrics; cumulative timings overlap and process CPU excludes native children.
Retain software-QA-only/no Oomakhi/no engineering acceptance and unchanged1percent/5percent limits/failure holds. Do not infer new build/install authority or bead completion from collection success.
